summary: Dragon Clan Personality review (issue #207): full audit of all 79 catalogue Dragon Clan Personalities against every primitive built through issue #204 (Dueling/Duelist), plus Rings/Kiho/deck-return. Wires Personality Wave 9 (34 cards, 69 previously unwired), showcasing three real self-performer Iaijutsu duels (Kitsuki Daisuke, Mirumoto Ichizo-exp, Mirumoto Shikei) plus new StraightenUnit/MoveToBattlefield primitives and several new Target categories. Logs a specific, accurate blocker note for the remaining 35 cards in docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx, dominated by an unbuilt 'after a duel/Iaijutsu action resolves' Reaction trigger (5 cards). Lane is 'shared' only because the packaging script's own generated card-artwork copies land under src/L5R.Client/Content/Published/ (the established convention for every prior content wave) -- no client UI code itself changes.
validation: dotnet build src/L5R.Core/L5R.Core.csproj: 0 errors. dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests: 127/127 core (including a new DragonClanPersonalityReview test covering all 34 real cards) + 34/34 published + 8/8 deck-format all passing. python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/content: 121/121. python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/collaboration: 43/43. docs/ROADMAP.md and docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx (241 wired) regenerated.
remaining: 35 of 79 Dragon Clan Personalities remain unwired, each with a specific blocker note in docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx. Several new small primitives touching shared validation logic (the even-if-bowed exception list, the Battle-timing AtBattle exception list) were deliberately kept narrow (id-based exceptions only) to limit blast radius.
